gbm_population_evidence.quote: Have histologically confirmed World Health Organization (WHO) Grade 4 glioblastoma, other WHO grade 4 malignant glioma or molecular GBM (based on the 2021 WHO Classification) at first recurrence. Patients with gliosarcoma are NOT eligible;

candidate_evidence.quote: This is a single center, open-label, Phase Ib trial evaluating the safety and tolerability of CUE-102 monotherapy in adult participants with Glioblastoma (GBM) at first recurrence.
A WT-1-pHLA-IL2-Fc fusion protein, single-use vial, via intravenous (into the vein) infusion per protocol.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Phase Ib Open-label Study of Adjuvant CUE-102, a WT-1-pHLA-IL2-Fc Fusion Protein in Glioblastoma (GBM) Patients at First Recurrence

role_evidence.quote: CUE-102 is designed to target tumor cells by activating T cells, potentially improving clinical outcomes in recurrent GBM.

agents.drug_class_hint: investigational WT1 peptide-HLA-IL2-Fc fusion protein (antigen-specific T-cell engager/immunomodulator)
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: designed to target tumor cells by activating T cells

coder_notes: Inclusion allows GBM, 'other WHO grade 4 malignant glioma' or molecular GBM (WHO 2021) -> mixed_glioma_gbm_named (other grade 4 gliomas, possibly IDH-mutant astrocytoma grade 4, are eligible). CUE-102 is a therapeutic fusion protein (WT1 peptide-HLA complex + IL-2), coded as pharmacological therapeutic protein rather than a cancer vaccine; adjudicator may consider whether it should be treated as a vaccine-like antigen-specific immunotherapy. HLA-A*0201 genotype is a germline requirement and is not recorded as a tumour biomarker per section 5; WT1 expression is not required. industry_support_in_text yes: Cue Biopharma provides the study drug.
